appearances.whereabouts: The Foregate of Cairhien, moving through streets, then to the Illuminators' chapter house on a hill outside the Foregate, and finally returning to The Defender of the Dragonwall inn
appearances.notable_actions: Leaves The Bunch of Grapes with Loial; is hunted by Trollocs and Darkfriends through the Foregate; enters the Illuminators' compound seeking refuge; kills a Trolloc with his sword; accidentally sets off a firework that destroys Trollocs and part of a building; escapes back to the inn; receives a note from Selene with crescent moon seal; worries about Selene and the Horn
appearances.demeanor: anxious, protective of his companions, conflicted about using saidin, frustrated and worried about Selene's capture

appearances.whereabouts: With Rand throughout—in the Foregate, fleeing from Trollocs, at the Illuminators' compound, and back to the inn
appearances.notable_actions: Discusses losing at gambling to Dena; fights and kills a Trolloc by breaking its neck; helps Rand escape from the Illuminators; tries unsuccessfully to stop Selene from going back
appearances.demeanor: troubled by having killed for the first time, nervous around the fireworks, apologetic about Selene's escape, protective of Rand

appearances.whereabouts: The Bunch of Grapes (mentioned as having just been there)
appearances.notable_actions: Won all the money back from Loial in gambling, called it 'a little lesson'

appearances.whereabouts: Appears suddenly in the Foregate where Rand and Loial are being hunted; accompanies them to the Illuminators' compound; goes back toward the Illuminators when they escape; her ultimate fate in this chapter unclear
appearances.notable_actions: Finds Rand and Loial during the Trolloc hunt; urges Rand to think of greatness and the Horn; helps them find a door into the Illuminators' compound; slips away from Loial and goes back toward the Illuminators when they are escaping; sends a note to Rand via an old woman servant
appearances.demeanor: composed, confident even in danger, mysterious, seems to orchestrate events, becomes angry when Rand resists talk of greatness

appearances.whereabouts: The room at The Defender of the Dragonwall inn, guarding the Horn of Valere
appearances.notable_actions: Cleans his weapons while waiting for Rand and Loial to return; inquires about their visit with the gleeman

appearances.whereabouts: Not physically present but directing Trollocs and Darkfriends to hunt Rand in the Foregate
appearances.notable_actions: Has Trollocs disguised as puppets hunting for Rand; coordinates the search to drive Rand eastward away from populated areas

appearances.whereabouts: Illuminators' chapter house on the hill east of the Foregate
appearances.notable_actions: Supervises preparations for a fireworks display for King Galldrian; berates Tammuz for the premature explosion; works to put out the fire started by Rand's accident; assigns Tammuz to menial tasks
appearances.demeanor: sharp-tempered, exacting, furious at Tammuz for the mishap

appearances.whereabouts: Illuminators' chapter house, preparing the display and dealing with aftermath of the accidents
appearances.notable_actions: Claims everything was ready for the display; cleans up after the first premature firework; is blamed by Aludra and assigned to buy manure as punishment
appearances.demeanor: defensive, feeling unfairly blamed, grumbling about his treatment

appearances.whereabouts: The Defender of the Dragonwall inn
appearances.notable_actions: Presents Rand with a sealed note delivered by an old woman servant; watches Rand and Loial with curiosity

appearances.whereabouts: The Foregate, disguised as a puppet
appearances.notable_actions: Disguised as a goat-horned puppet; attacks Rand when the disguise is dropped; is killed by Rand's sword

Selene pursues Rand and urges him toward greatness; Rand is attracted to her but confused by her; she sends him notes signed with crescent moon seal
Hurin serves and protects Rand, guards the Horn in his absence
Fain hunts Rand with Trollocs and Darkfriends, trying to capture or kill him
Aludra supervises Tammuz harshly, blaming him for accidents and assigning him demeaning tasks
Loial kills the Trolloc to protect Rand, his first time killing
Rand kills the goat-horned Trolloc with his sword when it attacks
Dena is associated with Thom at The Bunch of Grapes, appears to be his companion
